channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Amy Acton Says Trump, Vance Should 'Look at the Facts' After Ramaswamy Attack Ad
item.description: Ohio Democrat Amy Acton spoke to ABC News after a rally in Cleveland with former President Barack Obama.

item.title: Iran: U.S. Military Barred From Gulf "Under Any Circumstance"
item.description: The U.S. ambassador to the U.N. said the war with Iran could last another year, but expressed hope that Tehran would "come to the table" sooner.

item.title: Over 1,000 arrested in France amid protester-police clashes
item.description: Though demonstrations across France were mostly peaceful, police reported clashes with protesters on Saturday evening.

item.title: Kim Jong-un visits China to open new bridge, reaffirm ties
item.description: The North Korean leader used the trip to reaffirm ties with its powerful neighbor.
